summary: First real schema-aware Ruu and Ruu Cloud competitive-watch baseline. Twenty-seven seed actors and six newly admitted actors form a 33-actor radar. No actor demonstrated L3 or L4 autonomous-versioning outcome. GitLab was the strongest platform-level threat, while continuous eager convergence, exact in-flight dependencies and shared Cloud authority remained principal discriminators. U means indeterminate, not low threat.

coverage.reason: First real run; public and closed-source coverage was partial and canonical archive history was unavailable.

monitoring.admission_reason: Admitted during open discovery in this report.
pending_investigations: TOVIO: Inspect implementation artifacts when published.

findings.title: Platform convergence
findings.observed_change: Next-gen SCM, Duo Agent Platform, Orbit, /goal, governance and evidence moved toward an intent-to-agents-to-SCM-to-policy-to-production stack.
findings.guarantee_effect: GitLab was the strongest platform-level threat in this baseline.
findings.remaining_gap: No evidence established R4, R6, R7 or exact multi-host version authority independent of MR or PR lifecycle.
findings.next_investigation: GitLab: Inspect the actual Next-gen SCM state machine behind agent-facing APIs.

findings.title: User experience hides Git topology
findings.observed_change: The flow writ init, agent discovery, spec, seal, done and writ finish substantially hides branches and conflicts.
findings.remaining_gap: The workflow remained batch-oriented; R4, R6, R7 and multi-host Cloud authority were not demonstrated.
findings.next_investigation: Writ: Determine the exact point where intermediate state becomes safely consumable while the producer remains active.

findings.title: Writ 0.4.0 recovery
findings.observed_change: Doctor, repair, stale-claim detection, survival checks, bad-state finish refusal and index reconstruction were added or reinforced.
findings.guarantee_effect: R8-like robustness improved without closing R4, R6 or R7.
findings.remaining_gap: Continuous convergence, exact in-flight dependencies and global fixed-point progression remained unestablished.
findings.next_investigation: Writ: Determine the exact point where intermediate state becomes safely consumable while the producer remains active.

findings.title: Patch theory and visible topology
findings.observed_change: Patch theory, common graph, views and composable operations provide a strong R3 and R5-relevant substrate.
findings.guarantee_effect: Merge and reconciliation primitives are strong.
findings.remaining_gap: The user or agent still reasons about views and insertion topology.
findings.next_investigation: Atomic: Determine whether view and insertion topology can become entirely harness-managed and invisible.

findings.title: Recoverable database
findings.observed_change: Unified recoverable local database migration, recovery and concurrency were strengthened.
findings.remaining_gap: It does not establish R1, R4, R6 or R7 equivalence.
findings.next_investigation: Atomic: Determine whether view and insertion topology can become entirely harness-managed and invisible.

findings.title: CRDT provenance and read sets
findings.observed_change: CRDT line identity, batching, capabilities, provenance, gates, read sets and an explicit lease/workspace/submission workflow were established.
findings.guarantee_effect: Strong primitives and adjacent semantic-validation capability were observed.
findings.remaining_gap: Read-set sophistication is not a Ruu deficiency unless it replaces a Ruu version responsibility; explicit workflow remains.
findings.next_investigation: Weft: Track replication, push gossip and multi-gate quorums.

findings.title: Preventive scope leasing
findings.observed_change: Scope leases and overlap warnings were established.
findings.guarantee_effect: Collisions can be prevented or organized.
findings.remaining_gap: Prevention is not Ruu's non-preventive overlap and reconciliation semantics.
findings.next_investigation: Determine whether non-preventive overlap is supported.

findings.title: Preventive blast-radius leasing
findings.observed_change: Preventive blast-radius leasing and semantic-validation workflow were established.
findings.remaining_gap: Semantic correctness is not a versioning capability Ruu lacks; preventive leasing does not establish R3.
findings.next_investigation: Separate semantic validation from version-state mechanics.

findings.title: Agent convenience retains PR topology
findings.observed_change: Repository, base branch, working branch, PR, review and merge remain part of the workflow.
findings.remaining_gap: PR topology remains product semantics.
findings.next_investigation: Track whether topology becomes hidden exact state progression.

findings.title: Worktree topology remains visible
findings.observed_change: Async agents, worktrees and multi-root workflows were established.
findings.remaining_gap: Branch and worktree topology remains visible.
findings.next_investigation: Track hidden exact state progression.

findings.title: Stacked PR topology
findings.observed_change: Stacked-PR automation was established.
findings.remaining_gap: Automation does not eliminate the need for stack topology.
findings.next_investigation: Track whether stack topology becomes non-semantic.

findings.title: Explicit version topology
findings.observed_change: Better Git ergonomics were established with branch, stack, target and workspace concepts.
findings.remaining_gap: Explicit topology remains.
findings.next_investigation: Track whether topology disappears from ordinary use.

findings.title: Commuting changes
findings.observed_change: Independent changes commute and conflicts are first-class.
findings.guarantee_effect: Strong overlap and merge primitives exist.
findings.remaining_gap: No autonomous Ruu-style control plane was demonstrated.
findings.next_investigation: Inspect autonomous orchestration boundaries.

findings.title: Moving-target retry
findings.observed_change: Structural merge, validation and moving-target retry or re-analysis were established.
findings.remaining_gap: Explicit merge mechanics remain.
findings.next_investigation: Inspect exact state and continuous interleaving.

findings.title: Git distribution boundary
findings.observed_change: Cheap commits, conflicts as data, branchless local operation and crash-honest append log were established; distribution is left to Git and export does not publish.
findings.guarantee_effect: Local primitives and crash honesty are relevant.
findings.remaining_gap: The engine source was unavailable and distribution authority was not demonstrated.
findings.next_investigation: Inspect engine source and distribution when available.

findings.title: Agent-scale Git context
findings.observed_change: Git transport, context, provenance and future hosting direction were established.
findings.remaining_gap: Autonomous exact version coordination was not demonstrated.
findings.next_investigation: Entire: Determine whether Trails evolve from explicit merge and publish transitions into globally managed exact intermediate version state.

findings.title: CodeTree admission
findings.observed_change: Agent-native VCS positioning, operation tree, MCP, locks, queueing, rollback and explicit start, save, finish and rebase operations were established.
findings.remaining_gap: Preventive locks and explicit operations remain choreography; no multi-repository or multi-host fixed point was demonstrated.
findings.next_investigation: CodeTree: Inspect source or runtime for identity, locking, queueing, stale-state handling, recovery, multi-repository behavior and host distribution.

findings.title: Supafork admission
findings.observed_change: Git wire compatibility, cheap forks and branches, versioned storage, session capture and cloud continuation were established.
findings.guarantee_effect: Agent-scale Git substrate and downstream capture are relevant.
findings.remaining_gap: No continuous autonomous convergence was demonstrated and the core engine was not publicly inspectable.
findings.next_investigation: Supafork: Inspect implementation when accessible.

findings.title: TOVIO admission
findings.observed_change: Public material claimed capability tokens, per-file crypto, signed provenance, stable change identity, semantic diffs, first-class conflicts and Forge architecture.
findings.guarantee_effect: The claims identify potentially relevant primitives.
findings.remaining_gap: Implementation artifacts were unavailable; claims remain claims.
findings.next_investigation: TOVIO: Inspect implementation artifacts when published.

findings.title: Merget admission
findings.observed_change: Prompt-linked commits and goal, prompt and diff relationships were established; multi-agent merge was announced and autonomous version control planned.
findings.remaining_gap: Roadmap was not implementation and explicit version coordination remained.
findings.next_investigation: Merget: Track multi-agent merge and autonomous-version-control roadmap.

findings.title: re_gent admission
findings.observed_change: Agent-turn recording, content-addressed snapshots and prompt-level log, blame and show were established as complementary to Git.
findings.remaining_gap: It remains a weak Core substitute.
findings.next_investigation: Track whether context becomes authoritative version coordination input.

findings.title: Atlas admission
findings.observed_change: Commit, session, prompt, tool and reasoning association plus conservative patch continuity and shared memory were established while Git graph and branches remained visible.
findings.remaining_gap: Autonomous versioning was not demonstrated.
findings.next_investigation: Atlas: Determine whether richer session and code intelligence becomes authoritative input for version coordination or remains adjacent context infrastructure.

findings.title: No demonstrated L3 or L4
findings.observed_change: No actor received L3 or L4 for the autonomous-versioning outcome.
findings.guarantee_effect: The baseline found no demonstrated near or scoped equivalence.
findings.remaining_gap: Absence of observed evidence is not proof of absence of capability.
findings.next_investigation: Continue permanent monitoring and open discovery.

findings.title: Continuous eager convergence gap
findings.observed_change: Common systems converged after parallel authoring or task completion rather than A1, B1, A2 interleaving while producers remained active.
findings.remaining_gap: No inspected actor demonstrated the full continuous eager convergence outcome.
findings.next_investigation: Test producer-active interleaving.

findings.title: Exact in-flight dependency gap
findings.observed_change: No inspected actor established B consuming exactly A1 while A remained active and later produced A2 without B silently following A2.
findings.remaining_gap: Exact producer-active dependency semantics remained unestablished.
findings.next_investigation: Test exact in-flight consumption.

findings.title: Cloud shared authority differentiator
findings.observed_change: The target combines the same mechanics with broader authoritative facts, multi-host fencing and recovery, exact in-flight availability and canonical Team Development State.
findings.guarantee_effect: Cloud authority remained differentiated from platform workflow automation.
findings.remaining_gap: No examined actor established the complete scope.
findings.next_investigation: Inspect multi-host authority and provider-independent team state.

limitations: Inspection supports only the stated scope and does not establish full Ruu equivalence.

limitations: Inspection supports only the stated scope and does not establish full Ruu equivalence.

limitations: Inspection supports only the stated scope and does not establish full Ruu equivalence.

limitations: Inspection supports only the stated scope and does not establish full Ruu equivalence.

trajectories: This baseline establishes the first trajectory point; no prior report exists.
Agent-native VCS is not equivalent to autonomous version control.
open_questions: GitLab: Inspect the actual Next-gen SCM state machine behind agent-facing APIs.
Writ: Determine the exact point where intermediate state becomes safely consumable while the producer remains active.
Atomic: Determine whether view and insertion topology can become entirely harness-managed and invisible.
Weft: Track replication, push gossip and multi-gate quorums.
CodeTree: Inspect source or runtime for identity, locking, queueing, stale-state handling, recovery, multi-repository behavior and host distribution.
TOVIO: Inspect implementation artifacts when published.
Merget: Track multi-agent merge and autonomous-version-control roadmap.
Vox: Re-establish exact project identity and capabilities.
ANVCS: Re-establish exact project identity and capabilities.
Jujutsu: Perform a fresh evaluation against R1-R10 and C1-C8.
OpenAI Codex: Evaluate standalone version-state behavior separately from GitHub.
aweb: Perform fresh technical identification and evaluation.
positioning_implications: You manage intent. Ruu manages versions.
Ordinary use should not require users or agents to manage views, lanes, specs, leases, branches, stacks, operations, rebases, inserts or PR topology.
R4 continuous eager convergence, R6 exact in-flight dependencies and Cloud shared authority are primary discriminators.

limitations: The recovered historical payload did not preserve exact baseline search timestamps or queries; none are invented.
